html: <sherpa-slider data-label="Volume" min="0" max="100" step="5" value="40" data-show-value>
use: To pick one number on a rail between `min` and `max`, or a range with `data-type="range"`; `data-show-value` adds a field to type it. To type a number with no rail, use `sherpa-input-text` with `data-type="number"`.
